scientific_integrity: Full analytic proof with separate finite symbolic/numerical corroboration; qualitative no-cycle and certain attraction results explicitly credited to prior authors. Independent audit and validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic, homogeneous adaptive SIS; C2 monotone breaking/creation with C>0 and positive infection; recovery-normalized time. Does not address stochastic extinction, contact delays, multiple communities or nonmonotone responses; no finite-time asymptotic error bounds.
title: Critical contact-feedback decay and matched endemic onset in adaptive SIS dynamics
